login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to bid, follow lots and manage your wallet.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: A free account lets you bid on lots, follow auctions and keep a wallet for insurance amounts.
register.companyHint: Needed if you bid on behalf of a company. You can add these later in your account settings.
register.documentsHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB. Documents are private: only you and the eRecycleHub team can open them.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalid: The reset link is invalid, was already used, or has expired.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

apply.title: Apply for a seller account
apply.description: Companies that generate scrap or surplus materials can list lots on eRecycleHub. Tell us about your company; an administrator reviews every application.
apply.name: Contact name
apply.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. You'll sign in with it once the application is approved.
apply.noCategories: No categories are available for this country yet.
apply.done: Thank you. An administrator reviews your application and you'll receive an email when it is decided.
